notes:
Account summary: EU-headquartered travel platform focusing on B2C bookings across 14 locales. Heavy seasonality — 6x spikes during regional product launches and holiday windows. Goal: reduce average handle time (AHT) and deflection while preserving locale-appropriate tone. Interested in replacing current monolingual rules + translation pipeline with unified multilingual agent-assist and summarization flow.

Initial ask / value props: replace manual translation + human post-edit for Tier 1 chat with Redwood inference pipeline (streaming responses + locale-aware style layers). Reduce translation latency to <300ms median token-response for agent assist, and <800ms end-to-end for live chat in EU region. Must support simultaneous high concurrency for flash sales (target 1.2k concurrent conversations). Cost sensitivity: wants predictable per-session cost for budgeting — open to reserved capacity for peak windows.

Technical constraints: existing stack on GCP EU regions, Zendesk for ticketing, legacy SIP telephony, SAML-based corporate SSO + SCIM for provisioning. Legal requires data residency in EU, audit logs retained 13 months, and KMS-managed keys. Prefer models with strong multilingual performance (en, fr, de, es, pt, it, nl, ru, ja). Keen on lightweight quantized variants in Dedicated/Private for on-premise retail kiosks.

POC scope discussed: 1) ticket summarization + suggested reply generation (Zendesk macros via function-calling), 2) live agent-assist (inline suggestions, tone-adjust controls per locale), 3) automated triage + regional routing rules (latency & compliance aware), 4) surge behavior tests (simulated 6x baseline load). Success metrics: reduction in AHT by 20%, NPS lift for support interactions, 80% automated triage accuracy, median latency targets above.

Integration notes / asks from SE: need sample payloads for Zendesk function-calls, socket/streaming demo for low-latency suggestions, docs on prefix/KV caching and how it interacts with session isolation, examples of routing policy DSL for region/fallbacks. Also asked for a cost projection for mixed-mode (hosted + reserved dedicated for peak).

Security / procurement: security questionnaire sent (Drive link above). SSO test failed in staging (team reproducing with SAML assertion mapping). Legal requested data residency annex and encryption-in-transit proofs. Procurement asked for an enterprise-grade SLA and breach notification timeline.

Customer quotes: "We need tone control per market — German support answers should be more formal than US — and we can't have literal machine translations with wrong idioms." — Head of CX.

Sales notes / tactics: run a short focused POC (4 weeks) with clear demo: side-by-side comparison of human post-edit vs Redwood-generated reply (localized tonal variants). Propose Dedicated burst capacity for Q4 launch (closed window). Offer a one-off engineering workshop (SE + infra) to validate SAML and telephony integration.

Potential upsell: Redwood Optimize for quantization recommendations and batching profiles, Redwood Console retention add-on for longer audit logs, Private deployment for kiosk/on-prem nodes in continental EU.
